₹5,000 a month can become ₹50 lakh. So why does your SIP feel useless? 📉📈

Year 5: ₹3L in, ~₹4.1L
Year 10: ₹6L in, ~₹11.6L
Year 20: ₹12L in, ~₹50L

The growth shows up late, and most people quit in year 3. Save this for the day you want to stop.

How many years has your SIP been running? 👇

Figures assume 12% a year for illustration; real returns vary and nothing is guaranteed.
